basis.statement: Observed choice treatment: Deployment volume follows team activity; it is not assigned by the analyst. Observational design: back-door identification requires conditional exchangeability under the recorded graph, together with consistency, no interference and adequate overlap.
The graph “Deploys to incidents at lag three” (revision 813fcbd2) states the causes of deploys and incidents; a missing arrow claims there is no direct cause.
No unmeasured common cause of deploys and incidents exists. Test sensitivity to this assumption in the sensitivity chapter.
